taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: MASVS-PLATFORM; link association is separate from action authorization

controls.boundary: iOS universal links, custom schemes and action binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read associated-domain entitlements, association file, universal/custom URL handlers and downstream account/action selection. Record actual signed build and OS behavior.
controls.controlled_verification: On an owned test device compare a valid link with one controlled parameter/account/action change. Observe the app's consumed destination and whether it commits a protected operation or links the wrong account. Keep browser/app transition and confirmation prerequisites visible.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Registering a URL scheme or opening a page is not account takeover. A custom scheme can have weaker routing guarantees than universal links, but the protected consumer still determines impact.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind links to intended routing/account/action state and supported platform association checks. Retest legitimate links, the original parameter confusion and required confirmation behavior.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
